correctness.rationale: For every connected simple unicyclic graph and every finite abelian palette of size q>=3, the coboundary maps colorings modulo global translation bijectively to nonzero edge tensions with one cycle relation. Character orthogonality factors each signed multiplier into bridge factors q-1 or -1 and a q-term cycle sum. The elementary minimal-exponent congruence lemma forces exactly q-1 minimal exponents and one exponent larger by one, classifying every zero. Free cycle-character shifts give the exact q^(N-c) multiplicity, and Stirling gives the stated fixed-q asymptotic. A standalone independent exact enumeration checked 5209 Fourier coefficients for q=3,4,5, cyclic and Klein four palette cases, plus four length-six q=5 samples. No finite check is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete exact harmonic support is a natural recovery invariant for the proper-coloring constraint. The arithmetic criterion c=1 mod q yields infinitely many resonance transitions, q^(N-c) explicit extra-nullity, and a q-dependent polynomial decay exponent of invisible balanced modes. Equality of the ranks for all tree-attachment shapes of the same size is a structural statement. These results are neither a disconnected numeric slice nor a merely cosmetic translation of the earlier q=3 cycle case.
